_comment: Cluster Server config. Secrets (ipc.secret, database.url) must come from process.env.

server._comment_port: PN_LOGINSRVR=28000 — v15 client dials the character-select (login) server on this hardcoded port (MsgHdr.h:1421). 5400 is the internal CacheServer, not client-facing.

registration._comment: Controls which world servers may register, and how to register with the login server.
